owner_notes: The Python state machine remains business authority; LLM executors may not skip stages.
Repository wiring does not prove the current ChatGPT session has the optional SDK/runtime. The dispatcher must perform a session handshake.

CHAT_BRIDGED may provide generation-stage payloads where explicitly allowed, but it cannot certify semantic audit PASS. A public/chat-submitted PASS without the current owner-runtime audit trajectory fails closed at the controller/COMPLETE boundary.

The historical AuditProvenance label INDEPENDENT_EXECUTOR in the v0.7 schema denotes only a separate stage-bound owner-runtime judge run. It must not be represented as provider-attested or ATTESTED_ISOLATED evidence.

Material explicit user writing feedback on a persisted task must be captured through the owner plugin learning-evidence capability before durable personalized-learning claims; current-turn revision may still proceed if capture is unavailable, but durable personalized learning must then be reported unavailable.

Owner-generated methodology receipts remain UNVERIFIED_OWNER_RECEIPT and cannot self-certify Universal operational methodology conformance. Receipt 1.3 binds the owner record to an exact action, but Universal must still supply the independent action expectation and evidence/semantic verifiers.

The current general editorial quality corpus is NOT promotion-ready even for FINANCE_DEEP because only one complete held-out FINANCE_DEEP topic family exists. Complete cases are now immutable-identity-bound, but a second distinct held-out topic family and externally grounded promotion verifiers are still required. FINANCE_BROAD is also not ready.
Verifier callback presence is not independent execution attestation. Any claim of independent semantic verification still requires an execution identity/trace outside the owner harness.
